title: robbietilton/Compositor
why_read: A native Swift-based Photoshop alternative for Mac, interesting for developers curious about building complex image-editing apps outside Adobe's ecosystem.
analysis: This is a Mac-native image editing application positioned as an alternative to Photoshop, built in Swift rather than as an Electron wrapper, which likely means better performance and tighter OS integration. Building a full-featured raster/compositing editor is a substantial engineering effort involving layers, blending modes, filters, and performance-critical rendering code. Without more detail on feature parity, file format support, or architecture, it's hard to know how mature or capable it actually is versus existing open alternatives. Still, a genuine native competitor in this space is a notable undertaking worth a look for those interested in creative tools or Swift/AppKit graphics programming.
